LIMIT 1

  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_040") < '1985'
  AND (CAST(SUBSTR(T5."XCL_047", 1, INSTR(T5."XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
       + CAST(SUBSTR(T5."XCL_047", INSTR(T5."XCL_047", ':') + 1, INSTR(T5."XCL_047", '.') - INSTR(T5."XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL)
       + CAST(SUBSTR(T5."XCL_047", INSTR(T5."XCL_047", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) < 110.000
ORDER BY T3."XCL_040" ASC
LIMIT 1
